cards.title: 日常工作 · 晨间巡检发现 CRAH 加湿罐结垢、送风湿度偏低，开单更换并交班
cards.subtitle: 基础 Basic
cards.content:
**情境**：晨间巡检发现 C 区 CRAH-C2 加湿罐结垢报警、送风湿度低于下限，有静电放电风险，开 work order 更换并 handover 提醒监控 rack 进风与 uptime。

**对话**：
- A：Morning patrol shows CRAH-C2 flagged a humidifier canister fault, and the supply air humidity is sitting at 28% — well below our 40% floor. That raises a static-discharge risk around the racks.
- B：Got it. Let me log a work order to replace the canister and clear the fault after the swap. Keep CRAH-C2 online and lean on the redundant unit so we don't lose cooling headroom.
- A：Understood. I'll note it in the handover: swap the canister tonight, watch the rack inlet and supply humidity, and don't close the loop until the reading holds steady. Uptime stays the priority.

**重点表达**：
- `morning patrol` — 晨间巡检
- `log a work order` — 开（记录）一张工单
- `lean on the redundant unit` — 依靠冗余机组（维持制冷 / 不掉余量）

expressions.zh: 晨间巡检
开（记录）一张工单
依靠冗余机组（维持制冷 / 不掉余量）

cards.title: 故障排查 · CRAH 风机皮带打滑送风量下降，RCA 指向皮带磨损并确认冗余接管
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境**：监控发现 B3 区 rack 进风温度抬升、业务侧 latency 偶发毛刺，核实为 CRAH-B3 风机皮带打滑送风量下降，RCA 指向皮带磨损，确认冗余 CRAH 接管。

**对话**：
- A：B3 rack inlet just crept to 27°C and we're seeing latency spikes on the compute cluster. CRAH-B3 supply airflow looks 15% low — what's the root cause?
- B：Belt slip on the CRAH-B3 fan. The drive belt is worn, so the fan can't hold design airflow. RCA confirms it's mechanical wear, not a control fault.
- A：Good. Confirm the redundant CRAH picked up the load so capacity holds, then schedule a belt swap. Keep failover armed until the unit is back online.
- B：Confirmed — standby CRAH is carrying B3, chiller and PUE are stable. I'll stage the spare belt and close the RCA once airflow returns to setpoint.

**重点表达**：
- `belt slip / the drive belt is worn` — 皮带打滑 / 传动皮带磨损
- `the redundant CRAH picked up the load` — 冗余 CRAH 接管了负荷
- `keep failover armed` — 保持故障切换待命（不解除冗余）

expressions.zh: 皮带打滑 / 传动皮带磨损

expressions.en: the redundant CRAH picked up the load
expressions.zh: 冗余 CRAH 接管了负荷
保持故障切换待命（不解除冗余）

cards.title: 容量规划 · 新增网络汇聚机柜 R80–R82 上架，核算电力与制冷双上限并预留 headroom
cards.subtitle: 基础 Basic
cards.content:
**情境**：评估新一批网络汇聚机柜 R80–R82 上架，按设备铭牌折算热密度，交叉核对双路 PDU 电力余量与 CRAH 制冷 capacity 双上限，确认封闭通道、PUE 余量、预留 headroom。

**对话**：
- A：We're staging three network aggregation racks, R80 through R82. Before racking, let's check the dual-feed PDU power budget and the CRAH cooling-capacity envelope.
- B：Per the nameplate, each rack lands around 6 kW — 18 kW total. The column PDU shows 35% headroom and the CRAH still has cooling capacity to spare, so we're within both limits.
- A：Keep the hot-cold aisle contained and leave headroom in the plan so we don't over-provision. Confirm PUE stays in band and uptime is protected through the install.
- B：Agreed. With blanking panels in place and the aisle sealed, PUE holds and we keep margin for the next growth wave.

**重点表达**：
- `power budget / cooling-capacity envelope` — 电力预算 / 制冷容量上限
- `leave headroom in the plan` — 在规划中预留余量
- `don't over-provision` — 不要过度配置（避免过度预留）

expressions.zh: 电力预算 / 制冷容量上限
在规划中预留余量
不要过度配置（避免过度预留）

cards.title: 运维沟通 · 算力负载跟随冷源余量错峰调度，平衡 PUE 与 latency 并保留 fail-back
cards.subtitle: 精通 Proficient
cards.content:
**情境**：季度能效与 SLO 评审后，协调把批处理/训练任务错峰调度到冷源充裕时段（load steering），平衡 PUE、rack 进风与 latency，全程保留 fail-back 链路。

**对话**
- Ops Lead: After the quarterly efficiency and SLO review, we want to steer the batch and training jobs to the hours when our cooling headroom is deepest. Can we shift the heavy jobs off the 2-to-6 p.m. peak without hurting latency?
- SRE: Yes — if we load-steer the non-latency-critical jobs to the overnight window, the chiller plant runs closer to its sweet spot and rack-inlet stays well under limit. Latency on the interactive tier is untouched.
- Ops Lead: Good. Keep PUE in target and hold the hot-cold aisle contained. Most importantly, leave the fail-back path live so we can revert instantly if a chiller trips.
- SRE: Fail-back stays armed — we can snap back to the original schedule in under a minute. Uptime and capacity margin both look healthy.

**重点表达**
- `load-steering the batch jobs` — 把批处理任务错峰调度（跟随冷源 / 电价余量）
- `run closer to its sweet spot` — 让冷源运行在最佳效率区间（贴近设计工况）
- `leave the fail-back path live` — 保留 fail-back 链路随时可切回（不解除冗余）

expressions.zh: 把批处理任务错峰调度（跟随冷源 / 电价余量）

expressions.en: run closer to its sweet spot
expressions.zh: 让冷源运行在最佳效率区间（贴近设计工况）
保留 fail-back 链路随时可切回（不解除冗余）

cards.title: 跨团队协作 · 嘉善 D02 新模组机电带载联调，确认供电/制冷余量与 handover 口径
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境**：与项目建设团队协调 D02 新模组机电带载调试，确认双路供电与 CRAH 制冷余量、rack 落位与 handover 验收口径，守住 uptime。

**对话**
- Construction PM: We're ready to commission the D02 module — dual-feed power and the CRAH loop are wired. What do you need from us before we hand it over?
- Ops: First, load-test the dual-feed path and confirm the CRAH redundancy picks up if one unit drops. Then we'll walk the rack layout and the hot-cold aisle containment before sign-off.
- Construction PM: Understood. We'll stage the load bank this week and keep uptime the priority during the cutover. The handover pack will include the commissioning logs.
- Ops: Perfect — once capacity checks out and the aisle is sealed, we'll take it. Keep me looped on the commissioning trend.

**重点表达**
- `commission the module` — 对模组进行机电带载联调 / 调试投运
- `load-test the dual-feed path` — 对双路供电路径做带载测试
- `take it / take over` — 接管（验收后接手运维）

expressions.zh: 对模组进行机电带载联调 / 调试投运
对双路供电路径做带载测试
接管（验收后接手运维）

cards.title: 供应商对接 · 柴发 / 黑启动供应商谈判年度带载演练与应急响应 SLA，保无缝 failover
cards.subtitle: 精通 Proficient
cards.content:
**情境**：与柴油发电机 / 黑启动供应商谈判年度带载演练 + 应急响应 SLA 与本地前置备件，确保市电失压时 chiller/CRAH 连续制冷与 rack 供电无缝 failover，预留液冷 CDU 联动。

**对话**
- Facilities: We need the generator service contract to cover an annual black-start load test and a four-hour emergency response SLA. If utility power is lost, the chiller and CRAH must keep cooling without a gap.
- Vendor: We can commit to the 4-hour SLA and pre-stage critical spares locally. For seamless failover, we'll validate the transfer scheme so rack power and cooling ride through on the generator.
- Facilities: Good — and make sure there are no single-points-of-failure in the start sequence. We're also expanding liquid-cooling CDUs, so leave headroom to interlock them with the generator.
- Vendor: Agreed. We'll document the start logic, interlock the CDUs, and keep capacity margin so uptime holds even during a prolonged outage.

**重点表达**
- `black-start load test` — 黑启动带载测试（失电后自启并带载验证）
- `pre-stage critical spares locally` — 在本地前置关键备件（缩短抢修时间）
- `no single-points-of-failure` — 无单点故障（冗余设计原则）

expressions.zh: 黑启动带载测试（失电后自启并带载验证）
在本地前置关键备件（缩短抢修时间）
无单点故障（冗余设计原则）

cards.title: 故障排查 · 定压补水压力震荡致二次泵汽蚀，RCA 后确认冷源 failover 链路
cards.subtitle: 高级 Advanced
cards.content:
**情境**：巡检发现 B 排 CRAH 出水温度漂移、rack 进风逼近上限，计算集群 latency 出现毛刺；RCA 定位膨胀罐预充压力失配叠加真空脱气罐排气不畅，确认 chiller + 蓄冷罐 failover 链路完整。

**对话**
- Ops Lead: We're seeing CRAH supply temp drifting and rack-inlet creeping past 27°C in row B, plus latency spikes on the compute cluster. The secondary pump sounds like it's cavitating — pressure's hunting on the constant-pressure make-up system.
- Controls: RCA points to two things: the expansion tank pre-charge is way off spec, so the make-up can't hold setpoint, and the vacuum deaerator isn't venting — trapped air is feeding cavitation at the pump suction.
- Ops Lead: Got it. Confirm the chiller-plus-thermal-storage failover path is intact so we can ride through while we re-pressurize. What's the safe window?
- Controls: Failover link checks out — standby chiller and the buffer tank will carry row B for the 40-minute re-charge. Let's stage the work order and keep failover armed.

**重点表达**
- `pressure is hunting` — 压力震荡 / 频繁波动（设定值附近爬行）
- `re-pressurize the expansion tank` — 重新给膨胀罐充压（恢复预充压力）
- `ride through on standby plant` — 由备用冷源 / 蓄冷支撑度过故障窗口

expressions.zh: 压力震荡 / 频繁波动（设定值附近爬行）
重新给膨胀罐充压（恢复预充压力）
由备用冷源 / 蓄冷支撑度过故障窗口

cards.title: 容量规划 · 高密 GPU 机柜上架，按铭牌折算负载核对电力与制冷双上限
cards.subtitle: 基础 Basic
cards.content:
**情境**：评估新交付的高密 GPU 机柜 R48–R50 上架，按铭牌 15 kW/rack 折算实际运行负载，交叉核对双路 PDU 电力余量与 CRAH 制冷 capacity 双上限，确认封闭 hot-cold aisle、PUE 余量并预留 headroom。

**对话**
- Planner: We're staging three new GPU racks, R48 through R50. Nameplate is 15 kW per rack — what's our headroom after we de-rate to expected load?
- Ops: At measured ~11 kW per rack, the dual-feed PDU has about 30% spare, and the paired CRAH still has cooling capacity to spare. Hot-cold aisle is contained, so we're within envelope.
- Planner: Good — keep some headroom in the plan so we don't over-provision. What's the projected PUE hit?
- Ops: PUE stays under target; we've got margin, and uptime isn't at risk.

**重点表达**
- `de-rate to expected load` — 按预期负载折算（铭牌降额）
- `cooling capacity to spare` — 制冷余量充足
- `leave headroom in the plan` — 在规划中预留余量（防 over-provision）

expressions.zh: 按预期负载折算（铭牌降额）
制冷余量充足
在规划中预留余量（防 over-provision）

cards.title: 日常工作 · 蓄冷罐液位传感器假低位，开单校准并交班强调 failover 闭环
cards.subtitle: 高级 Advanced
cards.content:
**情境**：晨间巡检发现 B 区蓄冷罐液位传感器读数跳变、存在假低位风险（可能误触发停泵），开 work order 校准传感器，并在 handover 交代 failover 预案与制冷容量裕度、强调 uptime 闭环。

**对话**
- Operator: Morning patrol — the thermal-storage tank level sensor in zone B is bouncing around, reading a false low. If it trips the pump on a bad reading, we lose buffer capacity.
- Lead: Open a work order to calibrate the transmitter and trend it against the manual dip check. Until it's verified, keep the redundant CRAH and standby chiller armed.
- Operator: Right — I'll note it in the handover: failover plan stays live, cooling capacity margin is OK, and we don't close the loop until the sensor's confirmed good. Uptime first.
- Lead: Copy. I'll watch the trend overnight and flag if it drifts again.

**重点表达**
- `false-low reading` — 假低位读数（误报低值）
- `trend against the manual dip check` — 与人工探深（实测）做趋势比对
- `don't close the loop until...` — 在…确认前不闭环（工单不销）

expressions.zh: 假低位读数（误报低值）

expressions.en: trend against the manual dip check
expressions.zh: 与人工探深（实测）做趋势比对

cards.title: 供应商对接 · 与 CRAH 整机供应商谈判关键备件本地前置、交期与现场质保响应
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
- **情境**：为降低 CRAC/CRAH 关键部件故障后的停机风险，与精密空调 OEM 谈判风机/电机/表冷器等关键备件的本地前置、交付周期与含人工的现场质保响应 SLA，确保 chiller/CRAH 冗余链路由 uptime 守住。
- 小白：We're reviewing the CRAH fleet with your team. Can we pre-stage the critical spares — fans, motors, coils — at the local hub to cut lead time?
- 供应商：Yes. We propose a 24/7 parts-and-labor warranty with a four-hour on-site response, and the standby CRAH keeps the rack inlet in range during any swap.
- 小白：Good. As long as chiller and CRAH redundancy holds capacity, latency won't move and PUE stays in margin. Please put the SLA in writing.
- **重点表达**：
- `pre-stage the critical spares` — 关键备件本地前置（提前布放到就近 hub，缩短到场时间）
- `parts-and-labor warranty` — 含人工的整机质保（到场+更换都包）
- `cut lead time` — 缩短交付/到场周期

expressions.zh: 关键备件本地前置（提前布放到就近 hub，缩短到场时间）
含人工的整机质保（到场+更换都包）
缩短交付/到场周期

cards.title: 跨团队协作 · 与网络团队协调新增管理网布线，确认走线不遮挡冷通道、冷电余量
cards.subtitle: 基础 Basic
cards.content:
- **情境**：网络团队新增管理/监控网独立物理布线，需与暖通确认走线路径避开冷通道送风面、核对 rack 供电与 CRAH 制冷余量，确保割接期间 uptime 不被影响。
- 小白：The network team is pulling new management cabling. Let's make sure the trays run clear of the cold aisle so we don't block supply air to the racks.
- 网络工程师：Agreed. We'll route above the rack tops and keep the hot-cold aisle contained. Does cooling have headroom for the new switches?
- 小白：Yes — CRAH capacity is fine and we keep uptime during the cutover. Just confirm the rack layout before you start.
- **重点表达**：
- `run the cabling clear of the cold aisle` — 走线避开冷通道（不遮挡送风面）
- `keep the hot-cold aisle contained` — 保持冷热通道封闭隔离
- `keep uptime during the cutover` — 在割接/切换期间保持可用

expressions.en: run the cabling clear of the cold aisle
expressions.zh: 走线避开冷通道（不遮挡送风面）
保持冷热通道封闭隔离
在割接/切换期间保持可用

cards.title: 运维沟通 · 夜间 chiller 频繁启停致冷冻水波动，变更窗口调整群控死区并预设 failover
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
- **情境**：夜间低负荷时段 chiller 频繁启停（short-cycling），冷冻水温度波动、rack 进风轻微抖动，PUE 漂移；讨论在变更窗口内放宽群控启停死区、设最小运行台数，平衡 PUE 与 rack 进风/latency，并保持 failover 待命。
- 小白：At night the chiller keeps short-cycling — the supply water swings and the rack inlet twitches a bit. Latency is still OK but PUE is drifting up.
- 资深工程师：The staging deadband is too tight. In the change window, widen it and set a minimum run count so one unit doesn't hunt on and off.
- 小白：And we keep failover armed in case a unit trips? I don't want the hot-cold aisle to break.
- 资深工程师：Exactly. We hold CRAH capacity, watch rack inlet and latency, and roll back the deadband if the inlet creeps.
- **重点表达**：
- `chiller short-cycling` — 冷水机组频繁启停（短循环，伤机且扰动水温）
- `widen the staging deadband` — 放宽群控启停死区（减少频繁加卸载）
- `keep failover armed` — 保持 failover 处于待命（随时可切）

expressions.zh: 冷水机组频繁启停（短循环，伤机且扰动水温）
放宽群控启停死区（减少频繁加卸载）
保持 failover 处于待命（随时可切）

cards.title: 日常工作 · 晨间巡检发现空置机架盲板缺失致冷热混风
cards.subtitle: 基础 Basic
cards.content:
- **情境**：早班巡检发现 D 区一排空置（未上电）机架缺失盲板（blanking panel），冷风从空 U 位漏出、被热通道回风吸入，rack 进风温度缓慢抬升。
- 小白（巡检）：Morning patrol found several blanking panels missing on the empty racks in Row D. Cold air is leaking and the rack inlet is creeping up.
- 资深工程师：Good catch. Install the blanking panels before shift change and raise a work order. We need to keep the hot-cold aisle contained.
- 小白：Noted. I'll log it and hand it over to the night shift so uptime stays protected.
- **重点表达**：
- `blanking panel` — 机架盲板（封堵空 U 位，防止冷热混风）
- `morning patrol` — 晨间巡检
- `keep the hot-cold aisle contained` — 保持冷热通道封闭隔离

expressions.zh: 机架盲板（封堵空 U 位，防止冷热混风）

cards.title: 故障排查 · 冷冻水压差旁通阀内漏致末端流量不足、rack 进风升温
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
- **情境**：监控告警 Zone C 部分 rack 进风温度抬升、关键支付业务 latency 偶发毛刺；核查为冷冻水压差旁通阀（DPV）内漏，一次侧冷冻水短路回流 chiller，末端 CRAH 换热不足。核实备用冷源 failover 并复盘 RCA。
- 小白：We're seeing rack inlet temps climb in Zone C and latency spikes on the payment service. What changed?
- 资深工程师：The differential-pressure bypass valve is leaking internally — chilled water short-circuits back to the chiller, so the CRAHs get less flow.
- 小白：So the cooling at the racks dropped. Did we fail over to the standby plant?
- 资深工程师：Yes, standby chiller is online and holding capacity. RCA points to a failed valve seat; I'll stage a replacement.
- **重点表达**：
- `short-circuit back to the chiller` — 短路回流到冷水机组（旁通致有效流量损失）
- `fail over to the standby plant` — 切换到备用冷源
- `RCA points to a failed valve seat` — 根因分析指向阀座失效

expressions.zh: 短路回流到冷水机组（旁通致有效流量损失）

expressions.en: fail over to the standby plant
expressions.zh: 切换到备用冷源

expressions.en: RCA points to a failed valve seat
expressions.zh: 根因分析指向阀座失效

cards.title: 容量规划 · 评估 R70–R72 高密度存储节点上架，核算三相平衡与制冷余量
cards.subtitle: 基础 Basic
cards.content:
- **情境**：下月新增一批高密度存储节点落入 R70–R72，核算双路供电三相平衡与 CRAH 制冷 capacity，确认封闭 hot-cold aisle、PUE 余量与 headroom，防 over-provision。
- 小白：The new storage nodes go into R70 through R72 next month. Can we fit them without overloading power?
- 资深工程师：Power budget looks fine if we balance the phases. The dual-feed PDUs still have headroom.
- 小白：And cooling? Will the CRAHs hold the rack inlet within the limit?
- 资深工程师：Yes — closed hot-cold aisle plus spare CRAH capacity keeps PUE in margin. Just don't over-provision the row.
- **重点表达**：
- `balance the phases` — 平衡三相负载
- `dual-feed PDUs still have headroom` — 双路供电 PDU 仍有余量
- `don't over-provision the row` — 别把这一排机架塞太满（避免过度配置）

expressions.zh: 平衡三相负载

cards.title: 运维沟通 · 年度 SLO 评审后协调冷源群控升级，动态设 setpoint 保留 fail back
cards.subtitle: 精通 Proficient
cards.content:
- **情境**：年度可用性 SLO 评审后，协调冷源群控策略升级，结合 AI 训练负载峰谷动态设定冷冻水 setpoint，在变更窗口统一 chiller 群控与冷源冗余，保留 fail back，平衡 PUE 与 rack 进风 / latency / uptime。
- **对话**：
  - 主管: After the annual SLO review, we need to tighten our cooling strategy. Can we run the chillers smarter without risking the rack-inlet temp or latency?
  - 小白: Yes. I'll dynamically set the chilled-water setpoint against the AI training load curve, keep the hot-cold aisle contained, and hold a fail back to design point so PUE and rack inlet stay balanced.
  - 小白: In the change window I'll stage the chiller plant sequence and keep one redundant unit armed, so uptime is protected even if we trim capacity headroom for efficiency.
  - 主管: Good. Confirm the CRAH fan curve tracks the new setpoint, and log the RCA notes if anything drifts before we make it permanent.
- **重点表达**：
  - `dynamically set the chilled-water setpoint` — 根据负载动态设定冷冻水温度设定值
  - `hold a fail back to design point` — 保留退回设计工况的回退预案
  - `keep one redundant unit armed` — 保持一台冗余机组处于待命（在线热备）

expressions.zh: 根据负载动态设定冷冻水温度设定值

cards.title: 跨团队协作 · 与云 / SRE 团队协调新业务潮汐调度，确认机架落位与冷电冗余

cards.content:
- **情境**：与云 / SRE 团队协调新业务上线潮汐调度，确认机架落位与制冷 / 供电冗余，保证 uptime 与 latency 遥测共享，核对 rack 进风与 hot-cold aisle 温控边界。
- **对话**：
  - SRE: We're launching a burstable workload next week and need a couple of racks landed without tipping the cooling or power limits. Can your side confirm headroom?
  - 小白: We'll place them in the contained hot-cold aisle row and verify the CRAH capacity and power budget. As long as rack inlet holds, latency should stay clean.
  - SRE: What about failover if a CRAH trips during the spike?
  - 小白: The redundant CRAH picks up automatically and we keep uptime protected. I'll hand over the telemetry mapping so your SRE dashboard reads rack inlet and latency in real time.
- **重点表达**：
  - `burstable workload` — 潮汐 / 突发型负载（可突发扩容）
  - `redundant CRAH picks up automatically` — 冗余精密空调自动接管

cards.title: 供应商对接 · 与 BMS 群控供应商谈判冗余热备、年度 SLA 与本地前置备件
cards.subtitle: 精通 Proficient
cards.content:
- **情境**：与 BMS / 冷源群控系统供应商谈判控制逻辑定制 + 冗余控制器热备 + 年度服务 SLA，确保 chiller / CRAH 群控 failover 无单点，预留液冷 CDU 联动与 free-cooling 调度，争取本地前置备件与快速响应。
- **对话**：
  - 供应商: Our standard BMS package covers chiller and CRAH sequencing, but the custom control logic you asked for pushes the quote up. Is it really necessary?
  - 小白: We need the redundant controller hot-standby and a failover path with no single point of failure, otherwise a controller fault could take down the whole cooling loop and hit uptime.
  - 小白: I also want a yearly service SLA with pre-staged spares locally and a response window that protects free-cooling and future liquid-cooling CDU integration. Can you commit to that in writing?
  - 供应商: We can include the redundant controller, a 4-hour on-site SLA, and staged spares, and we'll leave capacity headroom in the logic for the CDU link.
- **重点表达**：
  - `redundant controller hot-standby` — 冗余控制器热备（消除单点故障）
  - `no single point of failure` — 无单点故障（高可用设计）
  - `pre-staged spares + on-site SLA` — 本地前置备件 + 现场服务等级协议

cards.title: 故障排查 · 自然冷却板换旁通阀内漏，chiller 负载虚高引发 rack 进风抬升
cards.subtitle: 高级 Advanced
cards.content:
- **情境**：自然冷却板换旁通阀内漏致冷冻水旁路、chiller 负载虚高、rack 进风抬升 + latency 毛刺；RCA 定位旁通阀密封失效 + BMS 关阀指令未生效，确认备用 chiller + 蓄冷罐 failover 链路完整。
- **对话**：
  - NOC: We're seeing rack-inlet creep and latency spikes on the east cluster, and the chiller is running hotter than the load justifies. Any idea what's driving it?
  - 小白: Looks like the free-cooling plate HX bypass valve is leaking — chilled water is short-circuiting around the coil, so the chiller carries phantom load. I'm running an RCA now.
  - 小白: Root cause: the bypass seal failed and the BMS close command never took effect. We've confirmed the standby chiller plus the cold-storage tank failover chain is intact, so capacity headroom holds.
  - NOC: Good. Keep the redundant chiller armed and watch the hot-cold aisle delta until maintenance swaps the valve.
- **重点表达**：
  - `free-cooling plate HX bypass valve` — 自然冷却板换旁通阀（节能/防冻旁通）
  - `short-circuit around the coil` — 冷冻水绕过盘管短路（旁路）
  - `standby chiller + cold-storage tank failover chain` — 备用冷水机组 + 蓄冷罐故障切换链路

expressions.zh: 自然冷却板换旁通阀（节能/防冻旁通）

  - 规划: We want to land two high-density inference racks at R55 and R56 next month. Can the row support them without breaching our limits?
  - 小白: Let's check both caps: the dual-feed PDU power budget and the CRAH cooling capacity. As long as we keep the hot-cold aisle contained, we stay inside the envelope.
  - 规划: What about efficiency and headroom?
  - 小白: PUE has margin, and I'll reserve headroom so we don't over-provision. Uptime stays protected while we stage the rollout.

  - `dual-feed PDU power budget` — 双路供电 PDU 电力预算

cards.title: 日常工作 · 夜班消警未闭环，晨间复核趋势并交班 RCA 初判
cards.subtitle: 高级 Advanced
cards.content:
- **情境**：夜班 NOC 处置 CRAH-C2 高压报警复位但工单未闭环、根因未清；晨间巡检复核 BMS 趋势曲线、补录 RCA 初判，并在 handover 交代 failover 预案与制冷容量裕度、强调 uptime 闭环。
- **对话**：
  - 小白: Night shift cleared the CRAH-C2 high-pressure alarm and reset it, but the work order is still open with no root cause logged. I'm reviewing the BMS trend now.
  - NOC: What did the curve show?
  - 小白: Condenser approach climbed before the trip — likely fouling. I've noted the RCA lead in the ticket and will hand over the failover plan and cooling capacity margin so the day crew closes the loop.
  - NOC: Appreciated. Keep uptime protected and make sure the standby unit stays armed.

  - NOC: Make sure rack inlet stays in the green band and PUE doesn't take a hit — keep me posted on capacity margin.

cards.title: 故障排查 · CRAH 风机 VFD 过载跳闸 RCA
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
- **情境**：末端 CRAH 风机变频器（VFD）过载跳闸、单台离线引发相邻热通道升温，核实冗余 CRAH 接管、业务 latency 可控，RCA 初步指向回风滤网脏堵致风阻升高。
- **对话**：
  - A: CRAH-09 tripped on a VFD overcurrent fault and went offline — the neighbor hot aisle is climbing past 30°C and we're seeing latency jitter on the east rack row.
  - B: The redundant CRAH on that loop picked up the load; rack inlet is back within tolerance. Did latency stay under SLA?
  - A: Yes, latency held. Preliminary RCA points to a clogged return-air filter raising static pressure until the VFD current tripped.
  - B: Let's swap the filter, reset the drive, and add filter differential pressure to the alarm set so we catch it earlier next time.
- **重点表达**：
  - `tripped on a VFD overcurrent fault` — 因变频器过流故障跳闸
  - `the redundant CRAH picked up the load` — 冗余 CRAH 接管了负荷
  - `add filter diff-pressure to the alarm set` — 把滤网压差加入报警清单

- **对话**：
  - A: We just saw the B-zone hot aisle creep past 32°C and latency spiked on the compute cluster. What triggered it?
  - B: RCA shows a BMS logic glitch shut the primary chilled-water motorized valve — CRAHs went cold-dark for four minutes before we caught it.
  - A: Did the standby chiller and the thermal buffer pick up the load?
  - B: Yes. Failover to the standby plant and the ice-storage buffer held rack inlet within tolerance; capacity headroom kept the hot-cold aisle contained.
  - A: Good. Let's add an interlock so a single valve command can't isolate a whole row, and close the RCA with the controls team.

cards.title: 供应商对接 · 与定压补水/真空脱气水处理设备供应商核对选型参数、交期与现场质保响应
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境：** 小白为冷却水/冷冻水系统的补给水处理改造，与供应商核对定压补水装置与真空脱气罐的额定流量、压力设定、到场交期与质保 SLA，确保 Q3 变更窗口前到货，并谈定备件本地前置，守住侧对 chiller/rack 进风/latency 的影响。
**对话：**
- 小白: We're retrofitting the make-up water side — constant-pressure make-up units and a vacuum degasser. Can you confirm the rated flow, the pressure setpoint, and the lead time before our Q3 change window?
- 供应商: Rated flow 8 m³/h, setpoint adjustable 1.5–4 bar; lead time 10 weeks with on-site commissioning. For warranty, we offer 2-year parts and labor, 24/7 in-region response.
- 小白: Ten weeks is tight. Can we pre-stage the key spares locally and tighten the response SLA? Our cooling capacity rides on a stable water side — any chiller trip pushes rack inlet up and spikes latency.
- 供应商: We'll pre-stage the pump seal kit and the controller, and tighten the SLA to 8-hour on-site. That keeps your PUE and uptime protected through the retrofit.
**重点表达：**
- `lead time` — 交期（从下单到到货的时间）
- `parts and labor warranty` — 含备件与人工的质保（全包质保）
- `pre-stage the spares` — 本地前置备件（提前把备件布到现场）

expressions.zh: 交期（从下单到到货的时间）
含备件与人工的质保（全包质保）
本地前置备件（提前把备件布到现场）

cards.title: 跨团队协作 · 与网络团队讨论新 GPU 集群上线后的东西向带宽扩容与上联规划，确认供电/制冷余量
cards.subtitle: 基础 Basic
cards.content:
**情境：** 小白配合网络团队为下月新 GPU 训练集群上线做规划，讨论东西向（east-west）流量扩容与上联链路，确认机柜供电预算与 CRAH 制冷 capacity 余量不受影响，全程守住 uptime。
**对话：**
- 小白: The GPU cluster goes live next month — east-west traffic will roughly triple. Do we have enough uplink bandwidth per rack, or do we need extra top-of-rack switches?
- 网络同事: Each rack now has 2×25G to the leaf; the cluster needs 2×100G. We'll add ToR switches and re-plan the cabling, but the rack power and CRAH headroom must stay green.
- 小白: Cooling's fine — the hot-cold aisle is contained and we keep headroom on CRAH capacity. The power budget per rack still has margin too.
- 网络同事: Good. We'll stage the switches in the change window and verify latency after cutover. Uptime stays protected.
**重点表达：**
- `east-west traffic` — 东西向流量（服务器之间的横向流量）
- `top-of-rack (ToR) switch` — 机柜顶部交换机（TOR）
- `keep headroom` — 预留余量（容量/电力/制冷裕度）

expressions.zh: 东西向流量（服务器之间的横向流量）
机柜顶部交换机（TOR）
预留余量（容量/电力/制冷裕度）

cards.title: 运维沟通 · 夏季高温红色预警 chiller 逼近满负荷，讨论错峰预冷与制冷调度变更窗口，平衡 PUE/rack 进风/latency
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境：** 气象台发布高温红色预警、室外湿球温度攀升，chiller 逼近满负荷、冷冻水供水温度抬升风险。小白在能效例会上讨论变更窗口内错峰预冷与制冷调度，平衡 PUE 与 rack 进风、latency，并预设 failover 冷源冗余。
**对话：**
- 小白: Red heat alert — wet-bulb's climbing and the chillers are heading toward full load. I want a change window to pre-cool overnight and shift the heavy compute load to off-peak.
- 能效同事: Pre-cooling makes sense; it lifts rack inlet margin before the afternoon peak. But watch the chilled-water setpoint — push it too low and PUE climbs.
- 小白: Agreed. We'll hold setpoint at design, keep the hot-cold aisle tight, and stage the standby chiller so failover's armed if one trips. Latency must stay within SLA.
- 能效同事: Let's log it as a scheduled change, keep capacity headroom for the spike, and roll back to normal once the alert clears. PUE stays in band.
**重点表达：**
- `pre-cool overnight` — 夜间错峰预冷（提前降温/蓄冷）
- `hold setpoint at design` — 把（冷冻水/供水）设定值保持在设计点
- `keep failover armed` — 保持故障切换待命（冷源冗余在线）

expressions.zh: 夜间错峰预冷（提前降温/蓄冷）
把（冷冻水/供水）设定值保持在设计点
保持故障切换待命（冷源冗余在线）

cards.title: 日常工作 · 晨间巡检发现冷通道地板送风口被遮挡，开整改工单并交班
cards.subtitle: 基础 Basic
cards.content:
**情境：** 小白晨间巡检 C 区，热成像发现 R18 排 rack 进风温度偏高，排查定位为冷通道一块地板送风口被临时线缆桥架压住、出风受阻；开整改工单清理并交班提醒巡检，守住 uptime。

**对话：**
- 小白: Morning patrol in Zone C — I found R18's rack inlet temp running about 4°C above setpoint. The thermal image shows weak cold-air supply along that row.
- 同事: Did you check the raised-floor perforated tiles? Last week someone routed a temporary cable tray right over the cold aisle.
- 小白: Exactly — one supply tile is blocked by the tray. I'll raise a work order to clear it and reset the CRAH supply fan to normal. Handover note: keep an eye on R18 inlet until the fix lands.
- 同事: Got it. I'll add it to the shift handover and verify the rack inlet drops after the tile is cleared. Uptime stays green.

**重点表达：**
- `morning patrol` — 晨间巡检
- `raise a work order` — 开一张整改/维修工单
- `shift handover` — 班次交接（交班）

expressions.zh: 晨间巡检
开一张整改/维修工单
班次交接（交班）

cards.title: 故障排查 · 冷却塔填料结垢致逼近温度升高、chiller 制冷量下降，核实 failover 并牵头 RCA
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境：** 白班监控发现 A 区 rack 进风温度周期性抬升、业务 latency 出现毛刺；小白 RCA 定位为冷却塔填料结垢、approach 温度升高致 chiller 制冷量下降。他核实备用冷源 failover 是否生效、制冷 capacity 余量，并牵头写 RCA，保持故障切换待命。

**对话：**
- 小白: A-zone rack inlet is creeping up on a regular cycle and we're seeing latency spikes on the east cluster. Chiller supply temp is drifting — I suspect the cooling towers, not the chillers themselves.
- 同事: Confirmed — tower approach is 6°C above design. The fill's fouled, so the towers can't reject heat and chiller capacity is effectively down.
- 小白: Is the standby tower staged and failover active? I want redundancy solid before we take a tower offline for cleaning.
- 同事: Standby's up, N+1 holds. CRAH fans are still holding the hot-cold aisle differential. Let's open the RCA: fouled fill → high approach → reduced chiller capacity → rack inlet rise → latency.
- 小白: Agreed. I'll own the RCA and schedule an off-peak clean. Until then, watch capacity margin and keep failover armed.

**重点表达：**
- `tower approach is above design` — 冷却塔逼近温度高于设计值
- `open the RCA` — 启动根因分析（RCA）
- `keep failover armed` — 保持故障切换待命（在线冗余）

expressions.zh: 冷却塔逼近温度高于设计值
启动根因分析（RCA）
保持故障切换待命（在线冗余）

cards.title: 容量规划 · 评估 R60–R63 新机柜上架，对比电力/制冷双上限并预留 headroom
cards.subtitle: 基础 Basic
cards.content:
**情境：** 小白规划下季度 R60–R63 新一批机柜上架：核算单 rack 电力预算与整列 CRAH 制冷 capacity，对比哪一侧先触瓶颈，确认封闭 hot-cold aisle、PUE 余量并预留 headroom 防 over-provision，守住 uptime。

**对话：**
- 小白: We're adding racks R60 through R63 next quarter. Before we commit the layout, I need to know whether power or cooling hits the ceiling first.
- 同事: Per rack, the power budget is 12 kW; the row's CRAH can cover about 11 kW each after we keep headroom. So cooling is the tighter limit, not power.
- 小白: Then let's cap each rack at 10 kW, keep the hot-cold aisle contained, and reserve headroom so we don't over-provision. What's the PUE impact?
- 同事: With the margin, PUE stays in band and uptime's protected. We'll flag R63 as the expansion slot if capacity runs out later.

**重点表达：**
- `hit the ceiling first` — 先到上限（先触瓶颈）
- `keep headroom` — 预留余量（容量裕度）
- `don't over-provision` — 不要过度配置（过度上架）

expressions.zh: 先到上限（先触瓶颈）
预留余量（容量裕度）
不要过度配置（过度上架）

cards.title: 运维沟通 · 电价高峰协调制冷降载与工作负载迁移
cards.subtitle: 精通 Proficient
cards.content:
**情境：** 电价高峰时段，小白协调云/业务侧做制冷降载 + 工作负载迁移，平衡 PUE、rack 进风与 latency，保留 fail back。

**对话：**
- 小白: During the peak tariff window this afternoon, I want to shed some cooling load on the secondary plant and migrate the non-critical workloads off the warm aisle racks. Before we touch anything, confirm rack inlet stays within SLA and latency doesn't breach.
- 云同事: The non-critical batch jobs can move to the secondary AZ in about 20 minutes. But the hot aisle on R10–R14 runs tight already; if we drop chiller staging, rack inlet could creep up. Do you have fail back ready?
- 小白: Yes — I'll keep one chiller in hot standby and hold the CRAH fans at minimum before we shed. We still have cooling capacity headroom on the critical racks; PUE drops about 8% in the window. If inlet temp trends up I fail back instantly and the workloads stay put.
- 云同事: Understood. I'll freeze the migration if rack inlet crosses threshold, and we keep uptime intact either way. Send me the go/no-go at 14:00.

**重点表达：**
- `shed some cooling load` — 削减部分制冷负荷
- `drop chiller staging` — 降低冷水机组级联运行（减载）
- `fail back instantly if inlet temp trends up` — 进风温度抬头立即切回原工况

expressions.zh: 削减部分制冷负荷
降低冷水机组级联运行（减载）

expressions.en: fail back instantly if inlet temp trends up
expressions.zh: 进风温度抬头立即切回原工况

cards.title: 跨团队协作 · 与网络安全/等保团队协调 DCIM 遥测接口合规评审
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境：** 小白与网络安全/等保团队协调 DCIM 遥测接口合规评审，确认实时 rack 进风/latency 数据可读、制冷冗余在线、uptime 不受影响。

**对话：**
- 小白: Our DCIM team wants to open a telemetry API so the security/compliance guys can pull live rack inlet and latency data for the 等保 audit. I need to make sure it doesn't expose control paths or touch the failover logic.
- 安全同事: As long as it's read-only and behind the DMZ, fine. But can we get CRAH status and chiller plant redundancy too, so we can prove uptime and cooling capacity are monitored in real time, and PUE stays auditable?
- 小白: Yes — we'll expose read-only metrics only: rack inlet per row, CRAH runtime, chiller N+1 state, and the hot-cold aisle differential. The control plane stays isolated, so failover and capacity decisions are untouched.
- 安全同事: Good. That covers the audit. We'll whitelist the source IPs and you keep uptime reporting as-is.

**重点表达：**
- `open a telemetry API` — 开放遥测接口
- `behind the DMZ` — 置于隔离区（DMZ）之后
- `control plane stays isolated` — 控制平面保持隔离（不被暴露）

expressions.zh: 开放遥测接口
置于隔离区（DMZ）之后
控制平面保持隔离（不被暴露）

cards.title: 供应商对接 · 与液冷 CDU 供应商谈判批量交付、本地前置备件与延保 SLA
cards.subtitle: 精通 Proficient
cards.content:
**情境：** 小白与液冷 CDU 供应商谈判批量交付、关键泵阀备件本地前置、延保 SLA 与现场响应，预留二次侧扩容与 chiller 联动冗余。

**对话：**
- 小白: We're scaling the liquid-cooling footprint by Q4 — twelve CDUs. I need firm lead times, local pre-staged spares for the pumps and control valves, and an extended warranty with a four-hour on-site SLA.
- 供应商: We can stage the pump and valve kits at your city hub within two weeks, four-hour response in contract. For warranty, five years parts-and-labor, but the secondary-loop expansion you mentioned needs a capacity study first.
- 小白: Agreed on spares and SLA. On the secondary-loop expansion — I want the CDUs pre-wired for the extra racks and a documented interface to the chiller plant so failover between liquid and air sides is seamless. Capacity margin must cover the next GPU batch.
- 供应商: We'll ship with the expansion ports open and hand over the chiller-interlock spec. With the standby CDU, redundant CRAH and a contained hot-cold aisle, your uptime and PUE target hold even during a maintenance swap.

**重点表达：**
- `local pre-staged spares` — 本地前置备件
- `four-hour on-site SLA` — 4 小时现场响应 SLA
- `pre-wired for the extra racks` — 为新增机柜预接线（预留扩容）

expressions.zh: 本地前置备件
4 小时现场响应 SLA
为新增机柜预接线（预留扩容）

cards.title: 故障排查 · 液冷 CDU 流量低报警致 GPU 降频与 latency 抖动，RCA 定位主泵气蚀+过滤器半堵
cards.subtitle: 高级 Advanced
cards.content:
- 情境：液冷 CDU 二次侧流量低报警导致 GPU 节点进液温度攀升、触发降频与 latency 抖动；牵头制冷与监控复盘 RCA，定位主泵气蚀 + Y 型过滤器半堵，确认备用 CDU 可 failover 并切换验证。
- 小白：We just got a low-flow alarm on the primary CDU's secondary loop. The GPU nodes on rack R18 are seeing rising coolant inlet temps and the training jobs are throttling — latency on the inference pods is spiking.
- 制冷同事：I see it. Pump speed is maxed but flow is down — classic cavitation on the primary pump plus a half-clogged Y-strainer. The standby CDU is healthy; do you want me to fail over now?
- 小白：Yes, fail over to the standby CDU and prove the handoff. While that holds, pull the logs and run the RCA — I need to know if capacity margin on the liquid loop is actually sufficient for the next GPU batch.
- 制冷同事：Standby CDU is carrying the load, inlet temps back in range, latency recovering. RCA shows the filter restriction dropped headroom; I'll schedule a strainer clean and re-baseline PUE on the liquid side.
- 重点表达：
- `low-flow alarm on the secondary loop` — 二次侧流量低报警
- `cavitation on the primary pump` — 主泵气蚀
- `fail over to the standby CDU and prove the handoff` — 切到备用 CDU 并验证切换

expressions.en: low-flow alarm on the secondary loop
expressions.zh: 二次侧流量低报警
主泵气蚀

expressions.en: fail over to the standby CDU and prove the handoff
expressions.zh: 切到备用 CDU 并验证切换

cards.title: 容量规划 · 核算 AI 训练机柜 CDU 制冷容量与二次侧流量余量，预留 headroom 防 over-provision
cards.subtitle: 基础 Basic
cards.content:
- 情境：为新到货的一批 AI 训练机柜核算 CDU 制冷 capacity 与二次侧流量余量，确认单 rack 散热负荷、封闭 hot-cold aisle、PUE 余量，预留 headroom 防 over-provision。
- 小白：We're adding three AI training racks next month. Before they go live, I need to confirm the CDU can handle the extra heat load without starving the existing liquid-cooled racks.
- 容量同事：Each new rack draws about 35 kW; the CDU has roughly 20% cooling capacity headroom and the secondary flow margin covers it. We'll keep the hot-cold aisle contained so the CRAH side isn't stressed.
- 小白：Good. So PUE stays in budget as long as we don't over-provision the loop. I'll reserve that 20% headroom and stage the racks one at a time.
- 容量同事：Agreed. Staging keeps uptime safe and lets us re-check inlet temps after each rack lands.
- 重点表达：
- `cooling capacity headroom` — 制冷容量余量
- `over-provision the loop` — 让环路过度配置（超配）
- `stage the racks one at a time` — 机柜逐台上架

expressions.zh: 制冷容量余量
让环路过度配置（超配）

expressions.en: stage the racks one at a time
expressions.zh: 机柜逐台上架

cards.title: 日常工作 · 晨间巡检 CRAH 冷凝水盘积水排水堵塞，开单疏通并交班
cards.subtitle: 高级 Advanced
cards.content:
- 情境：晨间巡检发现 CRAH-A 冷凝水盘积水、排水管轻微堵塞有渗水风险，开 work order 疏通并 handover 提醒监控 rack 进风与备用 CRAH 冗余。
- 小白：Morning patrol on Hall C — CRAH-A's condensate pan is holding water and the drain line looks partly blocked. If it overflows we risk water near the racks, so I'm raising a work order to clear it.
- 运维同事：Noted. While CRAH-A is down for the drain flush, is the redundant CRAH enough to hold rack inlet temps?
- 小白：Yes — I checked capacity; the standby CRAH covers the load and uptime is safe. I'll hand over the work order and flag it so night shift keeps an eye on rack inlet and the failover status.
- 运维同事：Good call. I'll add the pan cleaning to the PM checklist and confirm the alarm thresholds before you log off.
- 重点表达：
- `morning patrol` — 晨间巡检
- `raise a work order to clear it` — 开整改工单疏通
- `hand over the work order and flag it` — 交班移交工单并标注提醒

expressions.zh: 晨间巡检

expressions.en: raise a work order to clear it
expressions.zh: 开整改工单疏通
